name: spitting_end_with_pending_toolchange
description: PRZ_SPITTING_END with _TOOLCHANGE_PENDING.active=1 (TOOLCHANGE just queued a flush). Verifies that PRZ_SPITTING_END auto-fires ORCA_PURGE with the stashed FLUSH/RETRACT, clears active=0 first, and skips the standalone M104 restore (ORCA_PURGE handles temp + fans). Position simulates being at the chute after firmware prime.
